text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: —A~ya~be-san♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You broke your favorite mug the other day, 
right? So—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ta-da! This is a present for you♪

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
......If it's a replacement for that mug, 
I already bought one myself. So—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I'll just take the thought.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: —I had a feeling you'd say that♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Fufu, curious? Go ahead and open it up♪

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: This is...—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It's a mug sleeve♪ With this, it'll 
cushion the drop if it falls, and best of 
all—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It's super fluffy and so~ incredibly cute, 
right?♪

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ————That's not what I meant.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...I can't just unilaterally accept a gift 
without any good reason.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Fufu, it's not totally free, you know~?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: —Tadaa☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I actually bought a matching sleeve in a 
different color for Curren♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
From now on, Ayabe-san, you're going to 
match with Curren~!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I sometimes wonder.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Why do you go so far... to, um... get 
close to me?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I don't think there's anything in it for 
you—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Does anyone really need a reason to want 
to get closer to someone?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You told me before, Ayabe-san. "The true 
nature of the gravitational force pulling 
stars and celestial bodies together is 
still unexplained."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Don't you think... it can be the same for 
us?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I want to be close to you, Ayabe-san.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: —It's really as simple as that.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ————Juuust kidding♪

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Look, don't you think fluffy mug sleeves 
lined up together look super cute? Let's 
take a photo right away!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...For now, I'll take it. 
............Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Fufu♪

—Lately, the fluffy mug sleeve that Curren 
Chan recommended on Umastagram had become 
an absolute viral sensation everywhere.

I bought one to try it out, and... indeed, 
this irresistible fluffiness is amazing!
